name: Halden Crowmark
source_profile:
Halden Crowmark (LN) — Ranger-Captain

Sir Halden is a stern veteran of the War of Broken Banners who served under Aldric Voss before his elevation to the marquisate. An accomplished tracker and uncompromising disciplinarian, he believes that order and stable government are necessary if Blackvein is to become anything more than a collection of lawless mining camps. He is personally incorruptible, but his loyalty to Voss sometimes leads him to enforce decrees whose fairness he privately questions.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 18 (source excerpt; may be partial)
